cadence.description: Run summarization when new turns since last run reach 10, OR when accumulated new-turn tokens exceed 3000. Both conditions are evaluated at the end of each agent turn.

models.escalation_description: Use Haiku for routine summarization. Escalate to Sonnet for the full run when any escalation trigger is detected in the new-turns batch.

escalation_trigger_details.legal_language: Turn contains phrases such as 'per our SLA', 'as contractually agreed', 'pursuant to', 'binding agreement', 'terms and conditions', or references to specific legal instruments.
escalation_trigger_details.formal_commitment: Agent uses confirmatory language to promise a specific dollar amount, timeline, or named action: e.g., 'I can confirm', 'I guarantee', 'you will receive', 'we will ensure'.
escalation_trigger_details.regulatory_compliance: Turn references a named regulatory framework or data protection standard: GDPR, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, CCPA, SOX, FTC regulations, etc.
escalation_trigger_details.dispute_escalation: Customer mentions initiating a formal dispute process: chargeback, BBB complaint, legal action, contacting an attorney, or filing with a government agency.

compression_notes: Compress sections in priority order (top = compress first). Never compress customer_profile or commitments_made.

preserve_verbatim_details.customer_id: Internal CRM customer identifier, e.g. CUST-004821. Copy exactly as it appears in source.
preserve_verbatim_details.ticket_id: Support ticket reference number, e.g. TKT-2024-9871. Copy exactly as it appears in source.
preserve_verbatim_details.commitment_text: Full text of any formal agent commitment, particularly those involving SLA language, dollar amounts, or specific dates. Quote directly from the source turn.
preserve_verbatim_details.amounts: All currency figures mentioned in the session, including charge amounts, refund amounts, credits, and any disputed totals.
